note: The settings gear works on a Mac, and chess no longer freezes the app.
detail: On a Mac the gear opens the full settings page in the browser instead of the small panel.
The chess opponent thinks without holding the app up, and a game stuck on its turn wakes when you click.
The picked chess piece and its moves are highlighted in green instead of orange-red.
The built-in chess opponent takes a second or two to answer instead of snapping back.

note: /textless update now, and a calmer chess highlight.
detail: /textless update now installs a new version when the update card does not show above the prompt.
The picked chess piece and its moves are highlighted in green instead of orange-red.

note: /textless settings opens the full settings page.
detail: /textless settings opens the settings page on the website, like the gear on the card. /textless panel opens the small version inside the app.

note: A safety fix for community scenes.
detail: Scenes from the marketplace are checked more strictly for links that load from outside the file.

note: One chess board at a time, started with /chess.
detail: Chess is started with /chess and is no longer part of the card's rotation. While a game is open in a chat, the board takes the card there; /chess end brings the scenes back.
One board at a time: with the game open in two chats, only the one that started or took it shows the board.

note: Play chess on the card, minimize it, and a few fixes.
detail: Play chess in the chat with /chess, against a built-in opponent. The settings page lists it under Interactive sets with its commands.
Play against a built-in opponent with four levels, or against Claude with /chess claude. Your side is picked by chance.
Piece sounds on every move, with check, win and game over. Sound can be switched off on the board, and your own wav files in ~/.claude/textless/sounds replace the bundled ones.
Minimize the card to one line and bring it back, from the card or under any answer.
Quotes and scenes pick at random each turn, without repeating the last ones.

note: Quotes, your own sets and favourites, and a lighter card.
detail: 200 quotes, written on by a pixel quill.
Make your own sets and star favourites on the settings page.
Remove scenes you shared in the marketplace.
textless sends its note to Claude less often, so chats use fewer tokens.

note: Make your own sets, play chess against Claude, and a Nostalgia set.
detail: Make your own sets on the settings page: tick any scenes from any set.
Chess against Claude with /chess, on a board above the prompt.
New Minimal and Nostalgia sets.
Marketplace scenes name who drew them under the card.

note: New versions show above the prompt, and one press installs them.
detail: An update card offers each new version. Update installs it and reloads textless in the chat.
What's new, Share and Star on GitHub sit on the card once it has updated.

note: One pixel-art card while Claude works, and your questions listed under the answer.
detail: While Claude works, the chat shows one tall card of Clawd instead of every step.
When the turn ends, the answer shows with a done line. Questions, links and the next step are listed under it.
Pick scenes on the settings page, add your own pictures, or get more in the marketplace.
